_comment: The mob-summoned camp's aura: heals every wounded allied entity within 0.75 units for 12% of their own max HP every 60 ticks, uncapped target count, and casts light out to 2.0 units. The camp sits 0.8 units from its summoner, so shrinking the heal radius much below about 0.6 units stops the summoner being healed by their own camp. All values placeholder.
name: CampAura
